sentences.en: Instead, I called fisherman Dan Brennan, figuring he might have arose with the dawn.

sentences.en: The fact is that people spend hours figuring out these tricks, hours programming cheats into programs like the Cheat Engine, and then more hours talking about them online in communities like Facebook.

sentences.en: She didn't want to talk whilst I was there, figuring maybe the line was tapped or something.

sentences.en: Instead, she concentrated on figuring out what knowledge she could about the souls in the lake.

sentences.en: Now I'm just kicking myself for not figuring out the whole business earlier.

sentences.en: Figuring out the best party places for kids is helpful for families who do not have the space to host a birthday bash at home or the time to clean before everyone arrives.

sentences.en: Figuring out where to buy theme birthday corsages is as simple as heading to your local florist or party store.
sentences.vi: Tìm ra nơi để mua áo lót sinh nhật theo chủ đề đơn giản như đi đến cửa hàng bán hoa hoặc bữa tiệc tại địa phương của bạn.

sentences.en: Figuring out the answer to "Where can I book a birthday party?" is something that many busy people want to know.

sentences.en: The Internet is one of your best bets when it comes to figuring out a game plan for your dinner party.

sentences.en: That's not to say that it's easy to get on the show and compete, but figuring out how to apply is the first simple step.
